mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 while metformin is renally cleared; tolterodine's anticholinergic effects may impair gastrointestinal motility affecting metformin absorption, and both drugs can affect renal function.
action: Monitor for reduced metformin efficacy and gastrointestinal tolerability; ensure adequate renal function monitoring as tolterodine may reduce GI motility affecting metformin levels.
